public_open_space.name: 555 Mission St
public_open_space.location: Western side of Building, street level.
public_open_space.description: This large plaza has several art and landscaping features. It is located in front of 555 Mission Streets and runs along the west side of the building. There are several distinct sitting areas with different styles of seating.

public_art.title: Moonrise Sculptures: March, October and December
public_art.access: open space and artwork are always accessible
public_art.detail: Three mottled aluminum sculptures of oversized heads stand in the plaza outside 555 Mission Street.

public_art.title: Human Structures
public_art.access: open space and artwork are always accessible
public_art.title_note: The city's inventory titles it “Human Sculptures”.
public_art.detail: 62 life-size steel figures, water-jet cut and bolted hand-to-hand and head-to-toe, form five interconnected towers in a dozen coded colors. The dataset's title 'Human Sculptures' should read 'Human Structures.'
